role: analytic all-integer-queue extension of frozen support curve

rule.pure_rate_envelope: for every q in Z_+^3, max local support is attained by options 3, 5, or 8; exact Fraction comparisons prove every other local rate lies below their coordinatewise max envelope
rule.root_upper_bound: for two lanes, every root threshold upper bound is at most twice the maximum local support; if a maximizing pure option fits two copies, its mandatory homogeneous seed meets that bound and closes the search
rule.analytic_tail: all queues that can fail the replicated-maximizer condition lie in the inclusive integer box [0,40]x[0,18]x[0,15]
rule.global_extension: the frozen source box contains the analytic tail box; every queue outside the tail has zero returned gap already at K10, so every source K10..K120 maximum is the corresponding all-queue maximum
rule.quantity_separation: returned upper-minus-selected gap is the primary runtime certificate; oracle-minus-selected actual regret remains a separate offline result

claim_boundary: Fixed-catalogue, two-lane, deterministic cached-phase support guarantees for every supported nonnegative integer queue. The result does not extend to another catalogue, lane count, physical service distribution, or a continuous-valued queue API.
